title: Learning Samples Importance: Parameterizing Dual Variables in Everywhere Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Everywhere learning provides a principled framework for training AI models under constraints that must hold throughout the data distribution. In the dual domain, these pointwise constraints give rise to functional dual variables. In this work, we propose to learn these dual variables, motivated by the fact that their values encode useful information about the underlying constrained problem. By representing the dual variable as a parametric function of each sample, we enable the learned multiplier to be evaluated on new, unseen samples. This contrasts with standard empirical dual formulations, which assign an independent multiplier to each training sample. We characterize the error in the recovered primal solution induced by restricting the dual variable to a parametric function class and show that it is controlled by how well this class approximates the optimal statistical multiplier. translated_title: 学习样本重要性：处处学习中的对偶变量参数化
translated_abstract: 处处学习为一个原则性框架，用于在必须于整个数据分布上成立的约束下训练AI模型。在对偶域中，这些逐点约束会产生函数型对偶变量。在本工作中，我们提出学习这些对偶变量，其动机在于它们的取值编码了关于底层约束问题的有用信息。通过将对偶变量表示为每个样本的参数化函数，我们使学习到的乘子能够在新的、未见过的样本上进行评估。这与标准的经验对偶形式形成对比，后者为每个训练样本分配一个独立的乘子。我们刻画了由于将对偶变量限制在参数化函数类中所引起的原始解恢复误差，并证明该误差由该函数类对最优统计乘子的逼近程度所控制。此外，我们证明了学习到的参数化乘子……
tldr: 该论文提出将处处学习中的函数型对偶变量参数化为关于样本的函数，使学习到的约束乘子能够推广到未见过的新样本，并证明了由此导致的原始解恢复误差由参数函数类对最优统计乘子的逼近程度控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes parameterizing functional dual variables in everywhere learning as sample-dependent functions, enabling the learned multipliers to generalize to unseen samples, and shows that the induced primal solution error is controlled by how well the parametric class approximates the optimal statistical multiplier.
